## Data Preparation for Data Stories

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Install once if needed (uncomment if you haven't installed these before)
# install.packages(c("sf", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "jsonlite", "units"))

library(osmdata)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

```

```{r}
buurten <- st_read(
  "https://maps.amsterdam.nl/open_geodata/geojson_lnglat.php?KAARTLAAG=INDELING_BUURT&THEMA=gebiedsindeling",
  quiet = TRUE
)

buurten
```

```{r}
# Dissolve all buurten into one city boundary
amsterdam_boundary <- buurten |> 
  summarise() |> 
  st_make_valid()

plot(st_geometry(amsterdam_boundary), col = "black")

```

\
3. Download Street Lamps (The exact lamp posts)

```{r}
# Reproject buurten to Dutch CRS (meters)
buurten_proj <- st_transform(buurten, 28992)

# Dissolve into full Amsterdam boundary (multipart is fine)
amsterdam_boundary_proj <- buurten_proj |>
  summarise() |>
  st_make_valid()

# Convert boundary back to WGS84 for bbox querying
amsterdam_boundary <- st_transform(amsterdam_boundary_proj, 4326)

# Create bounding box for Overpass query
bb <- st_bbox(amsterdam_boundary)

```

3.  Download the street lamp data

```{r}
library(osmdata)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

set_overpass_url("https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter")

amsterdam_boundary_wgs84 <- st_transform(amsterdam_boundary_proj, 4326)
bb <- st_bbox(amsterdam_boundary_wgs84)

# Helper: download points for one tag pair
fetch_points <- function(key, value, bb, timeout = 180) {
  q <- opq(bbox = bb, timeout = timeout) |>
    add_osm_feature(key = key, value = value)
  osmdata_sf(q)$osm_points
}

# Fetch multiple lamp-like tags
p1 <- fetch_points("highway",  "street_lamp", bb)
p2 <- fetch_points("man_made", "street_lamp", bb)
p3 <- fetch_points("man_made", "lamp",        bb)
p4 <- fetch_points("man_made", "light_mast",  bb)

# Combine, keep only columns that exist across them safely
lamps_all <- bind_rows(p1, p2, p3, p4)

# Drop duplicates by osm_id (important)
lamps_all <- lamps_all |>
  distinct(osm_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Project + clip precisely
lamps_all_proj <- st_transform(lamps_all, 28992) |>
  st_filter(amsterdam_boundary_proj)

nrow(lamps_all_proj)
```

# 4. Dowload the lit-streets data from OSM

```{r}
set_overpass_url("https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter")

amsterdam_boundary_wgs84 <- st_transform(amsterdam_boundary_proj, 4326)
bb <- st_bbox(amsterdam_boundary_wgs84)

q_lit <- opq(bbox = bb, timeout = 180) |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "highway") |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "lit")

dat_lit <- osmdata_sf(q_lit)

lit_roads <- dat_lit$osm_lines |>
  mutate(lit = tolower(lit)) |>
  filter(lit %in% c("yes", "limited"))

lit_roads_proj <- st_transform(lit_roads, 28992)
lit_roads_proj <- st_filter(lit_roads_proj, amsterdam_boundary_proj)

nrow(lit_roads_proj)
```

```{r}
plot(st_geometry(amsterdam_boundary_proj), col = NA, border = "grey40")
plot(st_geometry(lit_roads_proj), add = TRUE, col = "cyan", lwd = 0.4)
plot(st_geometry(lamps_proj), add = TRUE, pch = 16, cex = 0.08, col = "orange")
```

```{r}
library(osmdata)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

set_overpass_url("https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter")

q_roads <- opq(bbox = bb, timeout = 300) |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "highway")

dat_roads <- osmdata_sf(q_roads)

# Keep only the road types you care about
roads <- dat_roads$osm_lines |>
  filter(highway %in% c(
    "primary",
    "secondary",
    "tertiary",
    "residential",
    "unclassified",
    "living_street"
  )) |>
  distinct(osm_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Project + clip
roads_proj <- roads |>
  st_transform(28992) |>
  st_filter(amsterdam_boundary_proj)

nrow(roads_proj)

```

```{r}
# Convert to WGS84 -- required for web maps... 
lamps_wgs84 <- st_transform(lamps_proj, 4326)
lit_roads_wgs84 <- st_transform(lit_roads, 4326)
boundary_wgs84 <- st_transform(amsterdam_boundary_proj, 4326)

# Write them as GeoJSON files
st_write(lamps_wgs84, "lamps_amsterdam.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE)
st_write(lit_roads_wgs84, "lit_roads_amsterdam.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE)
st_write(boundary_wgs84, "amsterdam_boundary.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE)
```

```{r}
buurten_wgs84 <- st_transform(buurten, 4326)
st_write(buurten_wgs84, "amsterdam_buurten.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE)
```
